description: Read up to 20 public Instagram or TikTok accounts; return posts aged 2 to 45 days whose views beat the account's average of its other recent posts, with multiplier, metrics and format tags. Each read charges the workspace wallet its measured cost up to a per-read limit; the reply names the tokens charged. If Storika is still reading, a repeat for the same accounts a few minutes later returns the result. Once a result is charged, repeats for the same accounts until 6 hours after the read started charge nothing more. A read that failed or charged nothing may not be kept, so a later call can start a new read at its own cost. Each campaign or niche call selects accounts again; a changed list starts a new read at its measured cost, even while another runs, unless that list has a reusable read from the past 6 hours. tagged_posts is a separate paid read of others' posts that tag or mention them. Example: platform tiktok.

account_source.description: Without accounts: saved competitors (default), campaign_id's enrolled creators, or the most-followed accounts in category niche.

brand.description: Brand whose saved competitors to read.

campaign_id.description: Optional campaign this read is for: the cost of a read this call starts counts there; competitors reads its brand's saved competitors.
